identity.real_world_identity_notes: The AMS2 identity represents the BMW Motorsport/Schnitzer P60 V8 works M3 GTR associated with the 2004 endurance campaign, not later inline-six PTG or Hitotsuyama conversions. BMW's period specification, a contemporary works-car test, a direct drive of restored P60 chassis M3-GTR-006 and period Spa footage support a six-speed H-pattern dog box. Later E46 race conversions did use sequential gearboxes, but that hardware is not inherited by this works-car baseline.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed round rim without display or shift lights.

driver_summary: The works P60 V8 used a six-speed H-pattern dog box: lift and rev-match. AMS2 substitutes a sequential stick and cut; PMR's H-pattern accepts flat shifts and coast downshifts despite its sequential label.
